timeline: Where did Malaysia Airlines Flight 370 go after military radar lost it northwest of Penang Island?
Satellite data revealed a flight deep into the southern Indian Ocean.
It flew six hours straight until fuel ran out completely.
Then the world's most expensive search began across empty waters.
Debris finally washed ashore on the African coast and Indian Ocean islands beginning in July 2015.
Yet the main wreckage was never found.
Two hundred thirty-nine lives vanished without a single trace.
New aviation rules now track planes everywhere.
And the greatest aviation mystery remains entirely unsolved today.
